name: Natsui Ryusei
source:
An elite-minded detective with an incredible desire to get ahead.

When it comes to work that will lead to promotion,

his motivation doubles.

He performs other tasks with minimal effort.

He's a talented young detective, but in reality he's full of complexes.

He's been a bookworm since he was a child,

and is knowledgeable about subculture in general.
[From [url=https://and-zero.com/characters/ryusei]Official site[/url]]
